SEC2 Provenance service skill initial release.

- Introduces the SEC2 trusted provenance service as part of the Nomos security services line.
- Details supported capabilities: blockchain/product provenance, AIGC content fingerprinting & watermarking, supply chain traceability, and digital asset lineage.
- Clearly specifies boundaries: does not operate statutory provenance certification platforms or issue official certificates.
- Provides links and references to related documentation, assets, and branding guidelines.
- Defines intended business roles, use cases, and operational caveats (compliance, deployment readiness, regulatory timelines).
- Outlines license (CC BY-NC-ND 4.0) and authorship.
